events.title: HARMA Closed Playtest Recruitment
events.summary: Hello players!We are currently recruiting participants for a new round of closed playtesting for HARMA.HARMA is a roguelike deckbuilder that combines traditional deckbuilding with RPG elements such as character attributes and equipment. events.summary: Dear Players,This is INDIRECT SHINE.We are extremely excited to reveal our roguelike deck-builder, HARMA, today!HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father.
